records.name: Vern Trace
records.biography_en: Vern Trace serves with the Assessment Detail of The Spill Boundary. The kit includes a small capped detector puck with one mint inset. Hypernormalization assignments send the crew where a dangerous card or an incident has unsettled a district.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Vern Trace treats the equipment check as the first useful part of every briefing.
